description: Data contract for DynamiX autoscaling experiments (Groups 1-3). Every run MUST emit these three CSVs. Column names, units, and dtypes are fixed so that dynamix_analysis.py and dynamix_plots.py consume the files without modification.

columns.name: condition
columns.source: one of conditions[] (G1) or aristo_orig_v1/aristo_mod_v1 (G2) or dynamix (G3)

columns.name: t_s
columns.source: seconds since load-driver start (0-aligned across replicates)

columns.name: offered_load_msgs_per_s
columns.source: load driver setpoint (MQTT publish rate) at time t

columns.name: throughput_acked_per_s
columns.source: PromQL: sum(rate(storm_topology__acked[1m])) -- fully-acked tuples/s across the topology

columns.name: capacity_max_bolt
columns.source: PromQL: max(storm_topology__capacity) over bolts -- Storm capacity of the hottest bolt (0..1+)

columns.name: executors_total
columns.source: Storm REST /api/v1/topology/:id -> sum of executors, OR PromQL storm_topology__executors

columns.name: supervisor_pods
columns.source: kubectl get pods -l app=supervisor --field-selector=status.phase=Running -o name | wc -l  (== Running replicas of the Supervisor StatefulSet)

columns.name: weight_scale
columns.source: computed metric 0.6*worker_util_ratio + 0.2*bolt_capacity + 0.2*latency_norm (ARiSto/KEDA trigger). Null for static.

columns.name: cpu_util_ratio
columns.source: PromQL: avg over supervisor pods of rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total)/pod_cpu_limit (optional; null if not collected)

rebalance_events.note: One row per scaling action. ARiSto rows come from the autoscaler OutputWriter log (topology rebalance); KEDA rows come from kubectl events / KEDA operator log (pod scale). Empty file (header only) is valid for the static condition.

columns.name: component
columns.source: for aristo: bolt/spout component id; for keda: 'supervisor'

columns.name: trigger_value
columns.source: weight_scale (or per-signal value) that fired the action; null if unavailable

run_metadata.note: One row per run_id (append across all runs of the campaign). Single shared file for the whole campaign.

columns.name: warmup_s
columns.source: leading window discarded from steady-state stats (default 120)

columns.name: cluster_spec
columns.source: JSON: node count, vCPU, RAM, k8s version, storm version
